title: Friday 150227
wodRaw:
[Workout 15.1](http://games.crossfit.com/workouts/the-open/2015#tabs-1)  
Complete as many rounds as possible in 9 minutes of:  
15 toes-to-bars  
10 deadlifts  
5 snatches  
  
*Men use 115 lb.  
Women use 75 lb.*  
  
[Workout 15.1a](http://games.crossfit.com/workouts/the-open/2015#tabs-1)  
6 minutes to find 1-rep-max clean and jerk   
  
Perform both workouts on a 15-minute clock, start Workout 15.1a immediately after finishing 15.1.  
  
Post rounds and reps completed for 15.1 and load for 15.1a to comments and/or register and submit your results as part of the [2015 Reebok CrossFit Games Open](http://games.crossfit.com/).  
  
Top male and top female after both workouts will receive $2015.
